create_symbol_requests.name: S-1200B45-M5T1
create_symbol_requests.description: ABLIC S-1200B45 4.5 V LDO, active-high enable, SOT-23-5. Datasheet Rev6 Table3. Pin4 internally open; permitted tied to VIN or VSS.

create_symbol_requests.name: MX512H
create_symbol_requests.description: Mixic MX512H dual-input H-bridge, SOP8. Separate VCC logic and VDD motor supplies. Pin map from Rev1.2 2020-12-11 page2.

pin4_rationale: S-1200 pin4 is internally open and explicitly allowed tied to VIN/VSS (Table3 note). Represented as passive NC so original optional-pad copper is retained; no hidden power role.
motor_output_types: tri_state reflects the documented high-impedance standby mode; both output pads remain separate.
footprints: Unmodified standard KiCad footprints; no custom footprint created.

U6.source: S812C.pdf Table1 p8 and Table5 p11; ABLIC_MP005-A.pdf p5 markings
U6.nc_policy: ABLIC allows internally open NC pins tied to VIN/VSS. Passive, no board ties invented.

Q8.graphics: Unmodified imported stock generic N/P artwork, normal pin numbers; unit1 NMOS, unit2 PMOS
Q8.metadata: Value, footprint, datasheet and description updated using a parsed S-expression after MCP property writer corrupted nested modern property syntax. The malformed intermediate was removed and generic parent was reimported; final native export and library audit pass.
